referenceDefiningTraits: Repeated teal arches with contrasting warm inset shapes create a distinctive printed paper texture.
Visible offset backing sheets, directional shadows, slight rotations and overlapping layers form a tactile cut-paper collage.
A separate text slip overlaps the patterned stack; large bold type contrasts with the curved thin connecting arrows.
Light and dark versions preserve the same construction while adapting surfaces, shadows and contrast.

perImage.viewMethod: view_image, full native-resolution PNG displayed in conversation
observations: Three distinct paper cards run left to right with arrows for 申請 → 確認待ち → 確定.
The middle card explicitly says 予約確定ではない; a check mark distinguishes the completed state.
The orange 日時を変更 route leaves 確定 and returns upward to 確認待ち. Bottom explanations state that only confirmed reservations can change and that there is no automatic approval.
Bold state names dominate; numbering, short bars, and smaller explanations create clear hierarchy. The route and text do not overlap.

consistency.reason: A coherent card language uses offset backing layers, lower-right shadows, small role-colored bars, bold Japanese type and matching thin arrows throughout. Horizontal stages, compact grid, stacked loop, wide parallel split and portrait branch are meaningfully distinct layouts adapted to the required ratios.

character.reason: The paper-card cue survives consistently, but the repeated patterned arches, conspicuous tilted collage and text-on-pattern overlap that define both references are lost. The shared Noto-compatible sans lettering is required by the briefs and is not counted as a loss for replacing reference Latin serif type. Pattern/Text/PNG literal labels are not treated as requirements.

batch.paletteAssessment: Visually uses white surfaces, dark ink, blue/deep initial stages, gray pending states, teal available/completed states and orange warning/return branches consistently with the common six-role palette. No pixel-level color equivalence was established.
batch.factualSummary: No required factual omissions, invented scenario facts, or reversed arrow meanings observed.

fontAndScaleUncertainty.font: Japanese glyphs are visibly complete and sans-serif. Raster-only inspection cannot confirm the actual font family, fallback resolution or Noto Sans CJK JP installation; source and runtime font records were intentionally not read.
fontAndScaleUncertainty.scale: Each PNG was actually viewed at its native recorded dimensions. Capture dimensions exceed the specified artwork dimensions by 48 pixels horizontally and 96 vertically; the visible frame contains outer margins and captions. The target artwork was assessed in that native frame without treating the larger frame as the requested artwork size. Exact placement bounds and browser device-pixel ratio were not read, so CSS-to-raster scale is not independently verified.
fontAndScaleUncertainty.scope: Only the two allowed reference PNGs, five allowed capture PNGs, their common briefs/checklists, common palette, and this dispatch were read. No SVG source, conditions, prompts, run records, coordinator scores or other runs were inspected.
